gen-dafont-origami-gf-esteban: A sign-painter's single brush stroke at constant width gives Origami its look, with lowercase dense as poured lead. Esteban follows with barely tapered strokes and an open e, making paragraphs go down smoothly.
gen-dafont-origami-gf-headland-one: Every stroke in Origami is one brush-drawn gauge, with lowercase heavy as poured lead. Headland One brings gentle weight variation and a round o nearly matching its capital O, giving the heading a courteous partner.
gen-dafont-origami-gf-ovo: Origami draws its letters like spaghetti laid out flat. Origami is striking at single-stroke display, while Ovo, with thins barely lighter than its thicks, is best at quiet, steady text.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-domine: Outrun Future is a constant-width outline you could trace with a finger. Domine adds compact ascenders and softly pinched curves, so paragraphs read with a gentle, dignified step from heavy to light.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-esteban: Esteban's lowercase looks oversized beside its capitals, and its thin parts barely slim down from the stems. Esteban softens the page with gentle brush-like pressure shifts beneath Outrun Future's outline of neatly bent pipe cleaner.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-halant: Wide-spaced and synthwave, Outrun Future draws every stroke like solder pulled through a nozzle. Halant then settles into a middling contrast, with outward-pointing terminals, so paragraphs read with sturdy, traditional authority.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-hedvig-lette: Authoritative from the first line, Outrun Future keeps its letters wide apart. Hedvig Letters Serif brings open-ended curves and stamp-like restraint, and its sturdy body against that pencil-flat heading is the best thing here.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-marcellus-sc: Wide, outlined, unshaded: Outrun Future never shifts from heavy to light within a stroke. Marcellus SC does the opposite job best, with mild pen-like modulation and pulled-back terminals that give literary dignity.
gen-dafont-ozone-fs-fira-sans: Technical and geometric, Ozone keeps stems and crossbars at a single thickness. Fira Sans opens its s curves wide and keeps a generous x-height, so paragraphs read cleanly with no stroke contrast to snag on.
gen-dafont-ozone-general-sans: General Sans fills the line with a large x-height and a smooth, unobstructed path around every bend. Ozone does geometric, technical display better; General Sans does running text.
